calibration.ref: NASA NSSDC fact sheet geometric albedo (solar-system.md 2.5)

albedo.tintRef: disc-integrated colour B-V 0.87 (Harris 1961 via Pace 1971, JPL TR 32-1523, table 1); tint = relative reflectance (R, V, B) as linear sRGB (R, G, B): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - (B-V)sun)), rho_R/rho_V = 10^(0.4 ((V-R) - (V-R)sun)), or without V-R the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength (B 440, V 550, R 640 nm: rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110)); (B-V)sun 0.65, (V-R)sun 0.53 (Johnson, as Karkoschka 2001). The map itself is monochrome.
